text: This report responds to the Board's request to develop two to three long-term economic investment scenarios and their implications for the Toronto Investment Board's long-term investment strategy. Confidential Attachment 1 to this report provides further detail regarding the scenarios.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 26, 2022) from the Director, Capital Markets, remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information that involves the security of property belonging to the City and the Toronto Investment Board.
